Visible components include a yellowish woven-cone mid-range driver with a black rubber surround and a central dust cap, positioned below an angled, pill-shaped tweeter module covered in black fabric. A portion of a larger woofer is visible at the very bottom edge. The background consists of horizontal wooden paneling.
